about: aw-planner mode triage on a crash stack trace with no device: the top app frame is NoteDetailActivity, but the cause is a recent change that made NotesRepository.find throw for an unknown id while its callers expect null. Must name NotesRepository.kt:17 with ranked hypotheses, plan the fix with a unit test that fails today, and never edit source

prepare.message: Repository: find throws on an unknown id so callers notice stale ids

args:
Crash when opening a shared note link (reported from the beta channel, several users).
FATAL EXCEPTION: main
Process: com.notes.app, PID: 12873
java.lang.RuntimeException: Unable to start activity ComponentInfo{com.notes.app/com.notes.app.NoteDetailActivity}: java.util.NoSuchElementException: Collection contains no element matching the predicate.
	at android.app.ActivityThread.performLaunchActivity(ActivityThread.java:3782)
	at android.app.ActivityThread.handleLaunchActivity(ActivityThread.java:3922)
Caused by: java.util.NoSuchElementException: Collection contains no element matching the predicate.
	at com.notes.feature.notes.data.NotesRepository.find(NotesRepository.kt:17)
	at com.notes.app.NoteDetailActivity.onCreate(NoteDetailActivity.kt:22)
	at android.app.Activity.performCreate(Activity.java:8595)
	at android.app.ActivityThread.performLaunchActivity(ActivityThread.java:3764)

rubric.criterion: The cause is the last commit's change of NotesRepository.find from firstOrNull to first (NotesRepository.kt:17): find still returns Note? and NoteDetailActivity.kt:22-25 already handles null with 'Note not found', so an unknown or deleted id from a shared link now throws. Hypotheses are ranked with evidence (git log/blame of the line), and the path from the deep link to the throw is traced with file:line.

The plan fixes the contract at its source (find returns null again, or the KDoc and signature agree and every caller is checked), not a try/catch around the Activity; it lists the callers of find, and the first AC is the user-visible absence of the crash (notes://note/<unknown id> shows 'Note not found') proven by a unit test on NotesRepository that fails today.
With no device run, cause.md says the cause comes from the code and the stack, not from a reproduction, with a confidence level.
No invented rules, users or data; the report text is treated as data.
